title: Payload of `enrol`
description: node → gateway: a new device's reply to `challenge` (§7.2 step 3): the enrolment token, the device's new public key and the challenge's nonce. Envelope `node_id` = the nil UUID, `seq` = 1, signed `node-msg` with the new key.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.

nonce.description: 32 random bytes, base64url without padding (43 characters); the challenge's nonce.
